Bug_Title: UR: Uninitialized read of field in constructor (UR_UNINIT_READ)
Bug_Details:
This constructor reads a field which has not yet been assigned a value. 
This is often caused when the programmer mistakenly uses the field instead
of one of the constructor's parameters.
Bug_Explanation: In the constructor of class 'UninitializedFieldBug', the method 'printName()' is called which tries to print the value of field 'name' which has not been initialized yet.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when an instance of UninitializedFieldBug is created, as this calls the constructor which reads the uninitialized field 'name'.
